result.note: Seeded final 4^4 tiling ready for manual drag/preview/save checks

children.tooltip: Click to select a color...
Start a new tiling design. (Shortcut: N)
Open a tiling design. (Shortcut: O)
Select a tiling design among built-in ones. (Shortcut: <Shift> + O)
Save the tiling design. (Shortcut: S)
Save the tiling design as code. (Shortcut: <Shift> + S)
Clear the translation vectors used to tile the plane. (Shortcut: U.)
Surround the design with copies using the translation vectors. (Shortcut: F.)
Remove all polygons that are not included in the tiling. (Shortcut: R)
Excluded all polygons from the tiling. (Shortcut: E)
Add a regular polygon with X side, where X is a number you entered with the keyboard. (Shortcut: <Enter>)
Preview the tiling design to verify plane coverage of the translation vector and included polygons. (Shortcut: P)
Select the two translation vectors used to tile the plane, using the mouse. (Drag with the mouse.)
Select a series of vertices counter-clockwise to draw a free-form polygon. (Click on vertices.)
Copy a polygon by drag-and-drop with the mouse. (Press C or drag with the mouse.)
Move a polygon by drag-and-drop with the mouse. (Drag with the mouse.)
Delete polygons by clicking on them with the mouse. (Shortcut: D)
Toggle the inclusion of polygons in the tiling by clicking on them with the mouse. (Shortcut: T)
Pan the view by drag-and-drop with the mouse. (<Shift> + left mouse button.)
Rotate the view by drag-and-drop with the mouse. (<Shift> + middle mouse button.)
Zoom the view by drag-and-drop with the mouse. (<Shift> + right mouse button.)
